shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The feeling of having conflicting attitudes about the same thing.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အကြောင်းအရာတစ်ခုတည်းအပေါ် ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်ခံစားချက်နှစ်မျိုး တစ်ပြိုင်နက် ရှိနေခြင်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: She felt ambivalence about accepting the promotion abroad.

publisher_source.source_summary: Mixed or opposing feelings simultaneously, not merely indecision.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: She felt ambivalence about moving abroad.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Something that seems to belong to a different historical period.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ခေတ်ကာလနှင့် မကိုက်ညီဘဲ အခြားခေတ်တစ်ခုမှ ဖြစ်သကဲ့သို့ ထင်ရသော အရာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The old payment machine looked like an anachronism in the modern shop.

publisher_source.source_summary: A person or thing out of its historical period; distinguish obsolete item from historically misplaced detail.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: သက်ဆိုင်ရာခေတ်ကာလနှင့် မကိုက်ညီသော လူ၊ အရာ သို့မဟုတ် အယူအဆ
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The digital watch was an anachronism in the historical film.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုအပေါ် ပြင်းထန်စွာ မနှစ်သက်ခြင်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: His antipathy towards unnecessary rules was well known.

publisher_source.source_summary: Strong dislike or opposition; noun may be countable or uncountable; patterns antipathy towards/to/between.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုအပေါ် ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန် မနှစ်သက်ခြင်း
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: Her antipathy towards unfair rules was obvious.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To hear both sides of a disagreement and make a decision about it.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အငြင်းပွားမှု၏ နှစ်ဖက်စလုံးကို နားထောင်ပြီး ဆုံးဖြတ်ပေးသည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: An independent expert was asked to arbitrate the dispute.

publisher_source.source_summary: Make a judgment to resolve a disagreement; verb transitive or intransitive; distinguish deciding from mediating.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: အငြင်းပွားမှုတစ်ခုကို ကြားနာစစ်ဆေးပြီး ဆုံးဖြတ်ပေးသည်
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: Both parties agreed to let an independent expert arbitrate the dispute.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Hostile and ready to argue or fight.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ရန်လိုပြီး ငြင်းခုံရန် သို့မဟုတ် တိုက်ခိုက်ရန် အသင့်ရှိသော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The passenger became belligerent when staff refused his request.

publisher_source.source_summary: Adjective has quarrelsome/hostile and formal war-related senses; draft is quarrelsome.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: ရန်လိုပြီး ရန်ဖြစ်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ငြင်းခုံရန် အသင့်ဖြစ်နေသော
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The customer became belligerent during the discussion.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Kind and willing to help other people.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: A benevolent donor paid for the village library.

publisher_source.source_summary: Kind/helpful adjective; distinguish charitable organisation use from personal disposition.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: ကြင်နာစေတနာရှိပြီး အခြားသူများကို ကူညီလိုသော
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: A benevolent neighbour helped the family after the flood.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The quality of expressing something in few words or lasting briefly.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: စကားအနည်းငယ်ဖြင့် တိုတောင်းစွာ ဖော်ပြမှု သို့မဟုတ် အချိန်တိုတောင်းမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The chairperson appreciated the brevity of her report.

publisher_source.source_summary: Uncountable noun can mean concise expression or short duration; draft example tests concise expression only.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: စကားအသုံးအနှုန်းကို တိုတိုတုတ်တုတ် ဖော်ပြနိုင်ခြင်း
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The committee appreciated the brevity of her presentation.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Careful to consider possible risks before acting or speaking.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လုပ်ဆောင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ပြောဆိုခြင်းမပြုမီ ဖြစ်နိုင်သည့် အန္တရာယ်များကို သတိထားစဉ်းစားသော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The director was circumspect when discussing the proposed merger.

publisher_source.source_summary: Formal adjective, cautious about risks and what one says; avoid equating with being timid.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: အကျိုးဆက်နှင့် အန္တရာယ်များကို ချင့်ချိန်၍ သတိကြီးစွာ ပြောဆိုလုပ်ကိုင်သော
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The manager was circumspect about promising a delivery date.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The use of threats or pressure to make someone do something.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးကို တစ်ခုခုလုပ်စေရန် ခြိမ်းခြောက်မှု သို့မဟုတ် ဖိအားပေးမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The agreement was invalid because it was signed under coercion.

publisher_source.source_summary: Uncountable formal noun: force or intimidation, not merely ordinary persuasion; distinguish technical linguistic coercion in corpus.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: မိမိဆန္ဒမပါဘဲ လုပ်ဆောင်စေရန် အတင်းအကျပ် ဖိအားပေးခြင်း
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The witness said the confession had been obtained through coercion.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A confusing and difficult problem with no obvious solution.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းနည်း မထင်ရှားသည့် ရှုပ်ထွေးခက်ခဲသော ပြဿနာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The council faced a conundrum over housing and transport costs.

publisher_source.source_summary: Countable noun: difficult problem or separately a trick question/riddle; draft uses difficult-problem sense.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းရခက်ခဲပြီး အဖြေမလွယ်ကူသော ပြဿနာ
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The team faced a conundrum when both options proved costly.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To provide additional evidence that supports a statement or account.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက်တစ်ခုကို ထောက်ခံသည့် အထောက်အထား ထပ်မံပေးသည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The photographs helped corroborate the witness's account.

publisher_source.source_summary: Formal transitive verb: add supporting evidence; avoid implying absolute proof.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက်တစ်ခု မှန်ကန်နိုင်ကြောင်း ထပ်ဆောင်းအထောက်အထားဖြင့် ထောက်ခံပြသသည်
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The records helped corroborate the driver's account.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Belief that a claim or explanation is true.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းလင်းချက်တစ်ခု မှန်ကန်သည်ဟု ယုံကြည်လက်ခံမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The new data gave credence to the scientist's explanation.

publisher_source.source_summary: Formal uncountable noun; patterns lend/give credence to; not interchangeable with personal credibility.

unapproved_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: အဆိုပြုချက် သို့မဟုတ် သတင်းတစ်ခုကို မှန်ကန်သည်ဟု ယုံကြည်လက်ခံမှု
unapproved_rewrite_candidate.original_example: The new evidence lent credence to her explanation.
